question: Whose song ‘Shaabaash’ became the anthem of Indian athletes at the Commonwealth Games 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nilotpal Bora**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Nilotpal Bora** is a renowned Indian singer and composer known for his contributions to Assamese music and Indian pop.
 
• The song **'Shaabaash'** by Nilotpal Bora became the anthem for Indian athletes at the Commonwealth Games 2022.
 
• The anthem **celebrates the spirit** and achievements of Indian athletes, inspiring them to perform their best.
 
• Nilotpal Bora's music often blends contemporary and traditional elements, making his songs popular across various demographics.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Commonwealth Games 2022**

 
 
• The Commonwealth Games 2022 were held in Birmingham, England.
 
• India achieved significant success, winning numerous medals across various sports disciplines.
 
• The Games provided a platform for athletes from Commonwealth countries to compete and showcase their talents.
 
 
 
• **Indian Athletes at Commonwealth Games**
 
 
• Indian athletes have a history of strong performances at the Commonwealth Games.
 
• The Games serve as an important event for Indian athletes to gain international exposure and experience.
 
• India has consistently been among the top-performing nations in the Commonwealth Games.
 
 
 
• **Role of Music in Sports**
 
 
• Music plays a significant role in motivating athletes and enhancing their performance.
 
• Anthems and motivational songs can boost team spirit and unity among athletes.
 
• Such songs often become symbolic of the athletes' determination and national pride.
